title: The Venom Primer
summary: A first primer on shaping venom qi into a bead a film and a touch; it teaches the stings every poison student starts with.

title: A Handbook of Gentle Toxins
summary: A handbook on numbing and drowsing toxins that dull a foe's hands and eyes without killing and cost the student little qi.

title: The Gall Keeper's Workbook
summary: A workbook on storing bitter gall qi in the gut so that a poison student carries ready toxin and shrugs off spoiled food.

title: A Primer of the Stinging Hand
summary: A primer on slaps and jabs that leave a welt of toxin qi and teaches the student to feel poison on the skin.

title: The Nightshade Drill Book
summary: A drill book that gives the qi of the poison plants a form: seed dart numbing touch ringed guard and hazy gaze.

title: A Workbook of Slow Poisons
summary: A workbook on poisons that act over many breaths: a seeded touch a slow bead and a shell that sours blows.

title: The Antidote Learner's Course
summary: A first course in turning poison qi against poison: drawing it out of skin tasting its strength and easing a sting or a bite.

title: A Handbook of Thorn and Spore
summary: A handbook on hardened thorns of toxin and drifting spore clouds that sting the nose and bind the hand.
